integrity: Exact all-dimensional analytical proof, supplemental SymPy/NumPy checker; no independent validation or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Only real self-Fourier Gaussian-polynomial functions of degree at most four vanishing at the origin, whose leading quartic is strictly positive on the sphere; excludes higher Hermite bands, indefinite or noncoercive top forms, and the global definite-set problem. Novelty is relative to inspected public literature, with residual bibliography risk.
title: Sharp negative-set volume and angular stability for quartic Gaussian Fourier eigenfunctions
